# Daniel Ordonez Arango

> Freelance penetration tester based in Colombia. Specializes in web application security and Active Directory attacks. Available for remote engagements worldwide in English and Spanish.

Daniel Ordonez Arango is a cybersecurity professional focused on offensive security. HTB Academy: 12 paths completed, 720 lab targets compromised, 105 modules completed, Top 1% ranking.

Contact: danielordonezarango@gmail.com

## Services
- Web Application Penetration Testing: OWASP Top 10, business logic, API security. From $2,000 USD.
- Active Directory Penetration Testing: Kerberoasting, lateral movement, privilege escalation. From $3,000 USD.
